title: HTTP binding — AXME pushes intent to agent's callback_url
description: Enterprise compatibility binding. The agent runs an HTTP server. AXME delivers the intent by POSTing to callback_url (managed delivery with retry and dead-letter tracking). The runner starts a local HTTP server on a free port and registers it as the SA's callback_url.

agents.description: step 1/1 — http: receives POST from AXME, validates event fields, resumes
